title: Review User Management and RBAC rollout
description: Lakukan review lanjutan untuk fitur User Management compact table, action center user, RBAC checklist role management, dan visibilitas menu berbasis role agar siap dipakai tim operasional.
notes: Verifikasi alur create role, duplicate role, delete role, dan save checklist RBAC.
Verifikasi aksi user: edit, detail, ganti password, ganti role, ban, dan delete.
Pastikan visibilitas sidebar mengikuti role yang dipilih.
completionDetails:
Redesigned User Management page to match One Chitra theme design with:
- Updated header with title, subtitle, and dark blue ADD NEW USER button
- 4 stat cards with accent borders (Total User, Active Access, Join 2026, Visible Result with progress bar)
- Filter bar with department filter and pagination
- Redesigned user table with NAMA, SN, DEPARTEMENT, ROLE, ACTION columns
- User avatars with initials fallback
- Department badges with muted styling
- KELOLA action buttons for each user
- Footer with cloud sync status and encryption level
- Applied light blue/gray color scheme (#F8FAFC background, #1e293b text)
